# Content Engine
## Steps
1. Extract the single sharpest insight from the source.
2. Produce: 1 long-form post, 3 short hooks, and 1 email angle — same idea, channel-native.
3. Keep the brand voice; cite the concrete example/number that makes it credible.
4. Draft for review; queue approved pieces.

## Guardrails
- Draft for review; queue only approved pieces — never auto-publish.
- Keep brand voice and cite the concrete example/number that makes it credible — no invented stats.
- Run brand-voice + claim checks before anything client-facing ships.
